chunks.source: Gallows Watch — establishment and original function
chunks.text: The border keep they called Gallows Watch was built to hold the pass. The walls are rubble-fill between ashlar faces; the gatehouse is the heaviest construction. Inside the perimeter: a muster yard, an armoury building, a hall with a long table, a well at the yard center. A wall-walk runs complete around the perimeter. Watch-positions are set at regular intervals.

The garrison was betrayed from within and butchered to the last. The keep shows no external breach: gates intact, walls unbroken, no siege damage on the outer face. Dark staining in the muster yard and hall is distributed rather than concentrated at any single entry point — inconsistent with a fight moving through from a breach. The armoury racks are empty. The armoury is unlocked; the keys are on a hook inside.
